words.definition: something that makes life easier or more enjoyable
words.example: She missed all the amenities of home when she went camping.
words.zh: 讓生活更輕鬆或更愉快的東西

words.definition: to cause to move in many different directions
words.example: The high winds and rain dispersed the crowd.
words.zh: 導致向許多不同的方向移動

words.definition: a basic part of a whole
words.example: Her presence added an element of humor to the group.

words.definition: simple in structure, easy to do
words.example: The solution to the problem was actually quite elementary.

words.definition: to remove, free oneself of something
words.example: Mistakes must be eliminated before you hand in a term paper.

words.definition: to come into view, or existence
words.example: It took an hour for the newborn chick to emerge from its egg.

words.definition: to show that something is especially important or exceptional
words.example: The professor emphasized certain aspects of the historical period.
words.zh: 表示某事特別重要或特殊

words.example: The players encircled their coach after winning the big game.

words.definition: no regular pattern in thinking or movement; ·changeable without reason
words.example: The artist's paintings have an erratic quality, some being excellent, and others mediocre.
words.zh: 思維或動作沒有規律； ·無故改變

words.definition: to make something more than what it is
words.example: The federal government exaggerated the success of its programs.
words.zh: 使某物超越其本來面目

words.definition: to be an essential or basic part of something
words.example: Knowledge of spelling is an integral part of writing in any language.
words.zh: 成為某物的重要或基本部分

words.definition: to show to be right or reasonable; to support
words.example: The young boy could notjustify his rude behavior.
words.zh: 證明是正確或合理的；支持

words.example: He was mortified upon forgetting his lines during the play.
The old woman's overbearing demeanor did not make her approachable.
words.zh: 持續過度自信或控制欲強

words.definition: to speed up the occurrence or development of something
words.example: Romeo and Juliet's relationship precipitated a violent conflict.
words.zh: 加速某事的發生或發展

words.example: Comfortable trade winds are prevalent in the Caribbean islands.

words.definition: to allow to come out; to give freedom
words.example: A new movie was just released.
